summary.en: Krka's development model focuses on branded generics, formulations and lifecycle improvements. Public materials report a large development portfolio without a named clinical-stage innovative-drug pipeline.
summary.zh: Krka的研发模式聚焦品牌仿制药、制剂和生命周期改进。公开材料报告了庞大的在研组合,但没有指名的临床阶段创新药管线。

watch.en: The R&D page reports more than 170 products under development.
watch.zh: 研发页面报告有170多个在研产品。

watch.en: R&D absorbed 9.1% of revenue in January–September 2026.
East Europe accounted for 36.7% of product and service sales in January–September 2026.
watch.zh: 2026年1-9月,东欧占产品和服务销售额的36.7%。

gaps: No named investigational assets with verifiable clinical phases found in reviewed sources; items is empty.
No phase counts or asset-level targets, origins or milestone dates disclosed in reviewed materials.
The R&D achievements page is undated; November 12, 2026 results confirm the generic-focused development model.
